decisions.statement: A run short of the last line answers how far the body reached.
A run reaching the last line answers that the body was read whole.
A record naming another body answers nothing already reached.
A body no line of which fits the room left over answers a refusal, not a run.
The room left over for a body is never less than nothing.
Nothing here writes to the record of the bodies an agent read.

definition: the run of lines a body too long for one answer hands back, and how far it reached
